outer_split.protocol: stratified 80/20 split of all labeled rows
outer_split.note: Only outer_train indices are used to form the inner split; outer validation labels are not used for threshold selection.

selection_rule: maximize positive-class F1 over threshold candidates; candidates are the midpoints between adjacent sorted calibration scores; np.argmax breaks exact ties by choosing the first maximum.

regularization_comparison.note: The regularization study uses the same seed-42 outer partition for its 262,508/65,627 fit/calibration split, but fits on all 262,508 rows and optimizes its own threshold on its 65,627 calibration rows. It is a different model/threshold-selection procedure.

evidence: The archived SGD-only finalization record contained the same threshold and inner metrics. This script reproduces them from the saved split indices and documented training configuration. Only the inner calibration model is retrained; no CV, regularization training, final model, or test prediction is rerun.
